title: Asked AI for a trailer for my game. Won't do it again lol
author: headlessdev_
selftext:
I asked Claude to make a trailer for Solarister, my multiplayer browser space game. What happened:

* Flights take 80 minutes, so it asked me to make its test account an admin
* Police only stop smugglers 2% of the time, so it set that to 100% in my balance file
* It took a smuggling job, saw the police on radar, chose "hold course" and got caught
* My pilot is in jail until tomorrow morning
* After 40 minutes of work it handed me 21 seconds of screenshots with zoom effects and sound effects it generated with sine waves

To be fair, it did change the balance values back afterwards.

If you want to get arrested yourself, guest login works without an account: [https://solarister.com/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=post&utm\_campaign=launch&utm\_content=r-aigamedev-2](https://solarister.com/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch&utm_content=r-aigamedev-2)

comments.author: sillygoofygooose
comments.body: It's a LOT of just clicking around, the tutorial wore me out. Needs more flavour to feel like you're not just clicking through a series of menus imo

replies.author: headlessdev_
replies.body: Hello, thank you really for the feedback! In the end its a browser game more like e.g. torn so really a lot of clicking around, but I will have a look how to include "more flavour" how you named it :)

replies.author: sillygoofygooose
replies.body: If it's the style then it's the style! I can see there's something fun beneath the presentation but I got worn down by a lot of rapid clicking through menus in the tutorial. Maybe a bit more animation/showing the possibilities of the world between tutorial stages would help to sell the world some more? A browser game can be a lot these days! And since you're developing with AI, animation is cheap to add.

comments.author: Hamurapa
comments.body:
If you ask AI about something than it do something. But it works in the same with humans :)
My advice that you didn't ask:
Make a little scenario, create mid pictures, explain  the flow (and 100+ other things).

AI is doing great but in cases where I'm really bad :)
